The BioWare Community Live Team presents:

'Neverwinter Nights: ShadowGuard' v1.1

Designed by: Ben 'Altaris' McJunkin

Starting Level: 3
Number of Players: 1

Trouble brews in Ghaarak, a northern outpost of the Sharakhan Empire. As the child of a local magistrate, you must chart a course through the city's treacherous intrigues and become a member of the Emperor's most elite defenders: the ShadowGuard.
